description: An English retelling that stays close to the folktale, following Snow-White and Rose-Red’s vow of silence as she spins bog-cotton into garments to break her brothers’ curse, survives a jealous stepmother’s deceit, and wins vindication at the pyre.
summary: A silent queen must weave twelve garments of bog-cotton to free her brothers from a curse before she is burned for a crime she did not commit.
